index.why.04.title: SEO & conversion

index.faq.label: Frequently asked questions
index.faq.title: We answer your questions.
index.faq.sub: A question not on this list? Contact us directly.
index.faq.a1: Each project being unique, our rates are established after analyzing your needs. A showcase site starts from €900. We also offer payment facilities to support you.
index.faq.a2: A showcase site is delivered in 1 to 3 weeks depending on complexity. An e-commerce project may require 4 to 8 weeks. We establish a precise schedule from the start.
index.faq.q3: Will my site rank well on Google?
index.faq.a3: Yes. Technical SEO is integrated from the start: semantic structure, loading speed, optimized tags, structured data. We also offer editorial support to go further.
index.faq.q4: Do you offer maintenance after delivery?
index.faq.a4: Absolutely. Our maintenance contracts include security updates, regular backups and minor modifications. Your site stays performant over time.
index.faq.q5: I have no technical knowledge, is that a problem?
index.faq.a5: Not at all. We manage the entire project and train you to manage your site at delivery. The interface is designed to be intuitive, even without technical experience.
